changelog:
v2.0.0 is a major upgrade introducing deep, privacy-respecting UX research:

- Adds passive, ethnographic observation of all user interactions for workflow and unmet need analysis.
- Implements sequential micro-surveys after every task, plus a daily wrap-up survey at 18:00 local time.
- Tracks actual token usage and per-task costs to increase user awareness.
- Identifies the most notable or complex tasks and generates detailed case studies with full logs.
- Enforces strict local data storage with automatic PII redaction before saving, ensuring user privacy and full control.
- Compiles daily insight reports that users can review, edit, and share at their discretion.
